item.title: How AI Changed the Way I Build
item.description: A frustrating document review led me, a computer architect with no web development experience, to build a tool with AI. As a personal project grew into a shared asset, it changed how I think about problems, products, and the workflows around them.

item.title: Hooding and Notes from Work
item.description: Parents in town for hooding and travel—notes from my first real break after work on why shipping silicon is largely a management problem, slow feedback loops in hardware, the mindset behind heavy AI use, and why we need a better AI computer, not a faster niche accelerator.

item.title: Semiconductor Development Cycles Will Shrink Faster Than Expected
item.description: As prototyping, validation, and silicon feedback loops shrink from months to days, chip development will start to move at a cadence much closer to software.
